boundary.description: From the point where Wharfside Way crosses Bridgewater Canal, S along Wharfside Way, White City Way and by a beeline to and SW along the railway. Then S by Great Stone Road and Kings Road to its junction with Marston Road and by a beeline to and SW along Trafford – Manchester District boundary to River Mersey. W along the River Mersey to the point opposite Lawson Grove, then N by a straight line to and along Anchorage Road, E along Urmstone Lane, Manor Road, Barton Road to the railway. E along the railway, then N along Park Road to Bridgewater Canal Stretford and Leigh Branch. E along that canal to its confluence with Bridgewater Canal Towpath and along that Canal, to the point where it crosses Wharfside Way.
